name: GAN 17 MagDrive 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core) - Jurassic World Edition
description: The GAN 17 MagDrive 3x3 Jurassic World is a licensed flagship collaboration that wraps GAN's MagDrive core system in a textured, movie-inspired dinosaur-skin finish, packaged inside a collectible hatching dino egg. It's a magnetic speed cube built for serious solving that also doubles as a display piece for Jurassic World fans.
features: Officially licensed collector piece: A genuine Jurassic World collaboration, numbered and themed down to the center cap logos, egg case, and dino-print bag.
Textured, movie-inspired finish: Dinosaur-skin surface detailing across every face gives it a look and feel no plain stickerless cube offers.
Gift-ready out of the box: Arrives inside a hatching dino egg case with a themed drawstring bag, so it's ready to give with no extra wrapping.
MagDrive core system: GAN's MagDrive architecture anchors the mechanism for stable, controlled turning.
MagLev feel: Repelling magnets replace springs for a smooth, consistent push through each turn.
Ball-core stability: The ball-core setup aids auto-alignment and keeps the cube planted during fast solves.
